github-jessfraz-dotfiles.description: A no-nonsense i3 rice from a veteran systems engineer — dark terminal-first, Inter for UI, JetBrainsMono Nerd Font for code, and urxvt as the daily driver. Feels like sitting at a grown-up dev workstation built for long shell sessions, not a showcase.

github-caelestia-dots-shell.description: The Caelestia shell is a QuickShell-powered Hyprland experience with meticulously custom QML widgets, a deep dark palette, and a polished, almost OS-like feel. Everything from lockscreen to notifications feels hand-designed — more like a curated product than a hobby rice.

unixporn-r5ot7x.description: A KDE Plasma rice built around Catppuccin Mocha Lavender — soft purple darks, crisp JetBrainsMono Nerd Font, and the usual Plasma panel restraint. Best when you want a modern dark theme without abandoning KDE's familiar widgets.

github-siduck-chadwm.description: A patched dwm build ('chadwm') paired with eww widgets, rofi, and Catppuccin across the board. A rare ultra-light window manager setup that still looks intentional and pretty — minimalist but decorated.

github-hlissner-dotfiles.description: Henrik Lissner's legendary dotfiles — Hyprland, foot terminal, rofi, zsh with zgenom, and zero window gaps. Focused, fast, dark, and practical; built by the author of Doom Emacs for getting actual work done.

github-xnm1-linux-nixos-hyprland-config-.description: A complete NixOS + Hyprland stack with Catppuccin Macchiato, Colloid teal icons, and every piece of the desktop configured: waybar, rofi, dunst, hyprlock, kitty, fish + starship, thunar, helix. The 'comprehensive reference build' kind of rice.

github-ryan4yin-nix-config.description: Ryan4Yin's NixOS config for niri — clean, scrollable tiling with Catppuccin colors, multiple terminals (foot, kitty, alacritty), and zellij for session management. Good reference for anyone migrating to niri on NixOS.

github-meowrch-meowrch.description: Meowrch bundles a polished Hyprland experience: Catppuccin Mocha, waybar, rofi, dunst, hyprlock, kitty, fish + starship, yazi. Feels like a distro-in-dotfiles — complete, opinionated, and ready for daily use out of the box.

github-ahmad9059-hyprflux.description: HyprFlux is a purple-accented Hyprland setup with a QuickShell panel, rofi launcher, swaync notifications, and a cohesive dark UI. The compact, purple-LED vibe feels like a cyberpunk terminal — intentional and focused rather than maximalist.

github-nickjj-dotfiles.description: Niri + TokyoNight Moon, waybar, walker launcher, mako notifications, ghostty terminal, zsh + tmux + neovim. A pragmatic developer-first setup focused on fast keyboard workflow and readable typography over visual flair.

github-frost-phoenix-nixos-config.description: NixOS Hyprland config with the Colloid theme, Papirus Dark icons, Bibata cursor, and Maple Mono everywhere. Clean and modern with zsh + powerlevel10k — a polished daily driver that leans toward refined rather than flashy.

github-elifouts-dotfiles.description: A rare *light-mood* Hyprland rice: Bibata Modern Ice cursor, CodeNewRoman Nerd Font, wofi launcher, swaync notifications, subtle animations with 10px rounded corners. Airy and soft instead of the usual dark maximalism.

unixporn-nhomed.description: AmogOS — a whimsical LXDE + Openbox + xfce4-panel rice styled as an Among Us send-up, with Arc Grey Darker theme and Papirus icons. Playful and memey rather than serious; a community-beloved joke-made-real desktop.

github-szorfein-dotfiles.description: Sway rice with huge 26px inner gaps, 16px rounded corners, polybar, Iosevka monospace, and eww widgets — an airy, sparse layout that treats whitespace as a design element. swayfx for the extra decoration.

github-cybersnake223-hypr.description: Purple-themed Hyprland with adw-gtk3-dark, Colloid Dark icons, Oreo purple cursors, and JetBrainsMono Nerd Font throughout. Waybar + rofi + mako + hyprlock + yazi — a full modern Wayland stack with a distinctive grape palette.

github-dusklinux-dusky.description: Dusky is a GNOME-adjacent Hyprland rice — adw-gtk3 theme, Papirus icons, Bibata cursor, Adwaita Sans UI font, and JetBrainsMono Nerd Font for code. Matugen-driven wallpaper-aware colors keep the whole desktop feeling coherent.

unixporn-1k7c8i1.description: Pastel bspwm rice with a soft #AEAED1 accent, waybar, rofi, dunst, Space Mono Nerd Font. Light-mood and airy — a gentle, almost pastel alternative to the sea of dark rices.

github-dustinlyons-nixos-config.description: Dustin Lyons' Plasma + NixOS + nix-darwin config — Inter UI font, polybar, Emacs as the editor, and plasma-manager plus home-manager to keep it all declarative across Mac and Linux.

unixporn-1kcebee.description: A first-timer's Hyprland rice built on the mylinuxforwork dotfiles — quickshell panel, rofi launcher, swaync, hyprlock, kitty, fish. Adaptive Material-themed colors based on wallpaper; a clean, approachable starting point.

github-aymanlyesri-archeclipse.description: ArchEclipse uses AGS v3 (GTK widgets) as the panel with pywal-driven dynamic colors — a chameleon rice that rethemes around whatever wallpaper you pick. Hyprland + kitty + zsh + starship + ranger for the dev side.

github-snowarch-inir.description: A compact niri rice with Catppuccin Mocha Lavender, fuzzel launcher, kitty terminal, and fish + starship. Takes advantage of niri's scrollable tiling for a more relaxed, horizontal workflow than traditional WMs.

github-yurihikari-garuda-hyprdots.description: Garuda-flavored Hyprland — Catppuccin Macchiato Mauve theme, Tela Circle purple icons, BreezeX-RosePine cursor, and full-on maximalist animations. Rich, colorful, and unapologetically decorated.

github-ad1822-hyprdots.description: A Catppuccin Macchiato Hyprland rice with Iosevka Nerd Font, Papirus icons, JetBrains Mono for code, and animations *off* for speed. Feels like a tasteful daily driver — small gaps, 6px corners, no flash.

github-cebem1nt-dotfiles.description: 'Kripton' theme on Hyprland — CaskaydiaCove Nerd Font, Bibata cursor, alacritty + zsh + thunar. A balanced dark setup with waybar, rofi, swaync, hyprlock and neovim for editing.

github-ayamir-dotfiles.description: A dwm rice with Catppuccin colors, polybar, rofi, dunst, kitty terminal, and fish shell. Proves that even a suckless stack can look clean and cohesive with the right config.

github-2ssk-dot-files.description: A TokyoNight Hyprland rice with Bibata cursor, JetBrainsMono Nerd Font, waybar, rofi, dunst, hyprlock, kitty, fish + starship, yazi. A comprehensive, middle-of-the-road dark setup — nothing unusual, everything polished.

github-sejjy-mechabar.description: Mechabar is a Waybar-focused Hyprland rice with Catppuccin themes and Commit Mono Nerd Font. The panel itself is the showpiece — dense, structured, with modular components you can borrow.

github-zproger-bspwm-dotfiles.description: A light-mood bspwm rice with polybar, rofi, alacritty, fish, ranger, and neovim. Distinctly airier than most bspwm configs — feels like a bright studio rather than a hacker den.

github-debuggyo-exo.description: Exo blends Hyprland with Material Design 3 principles — adw-gtk3, maximalist animations, 20px rounded corners, Matugen-driven adaptive colors via swww. Feels like a designer Android ROM for your desktop.

github-endeavouros-team-endeavouros-i3wm.description: EndeavourOS's official i3wm reference setup: arc-dark theme, rofi, dunst, thunar, xed. Conservative and well-documented — a perfect starting point for someone new to tiling.

github-swaykh-dotfiles.description: Niri rice with Pywal16-driven colors (so the whole desktop reshapes around your wallpaper), waybar, rofi, dunst, hyprlock, kitty, zsh + starship, lf file manager, neovim. Sparse 5px gaps, no animations.

github-dikiaap-dotfiles.description: A classic i3 setup with the Arc theme, Paper icons, DMZ-White cursor, Source Sans Pro UI font, Hack for code. i3bar + rofi + dunst + zsh + alacritty + tmux — the kind of reliable, boring-in-a-good-way rice that just works.

github-zhaleff-blacknode.description: Catppuccin Mocha Hyprland build with wallust-generated palettes tied to the wallpaper — waybar, rofi, dunst, hyprlock, kitty, zsh, yazi, neovim. Minimal fuss; the whole look updates when you change the wallpaper.

github-dmadisetti-dots.description: i3 with blur enabled and *huge* 40px outer gaps — Inter UI, fish + polybar + rofi + dunst + kitty + vim. Breathing-room maximalism: negative space as the core aesthetic principle.

github-jguer-dotfiles.description: A TokyoNight sway rice with Inter Medium UI, FiraCode Nerd Font for code, waybar, wofi, swaylock-effects, kitty, and neovim. A measured, evenly-tuned Wayland setup from a maintainer of yay.

github-cxorz-dotfiles-hyprland.description: 'Material Black Blueberry' Hyprland — a ChromeOS-flavored take on Material Design 3 with a #268BD2 blue accent, maximalist animations, 10px rounded corners, quickshell-style panels and yazi.

github-pazl27-dotfiles.description: Gruvbox Hyprland with CodeNewRoman Nerd Font UI and JetBrainsMono Nerd Font for code — waybar, rofi, dunst, hyprlock, kitty, zsh, yazi, neovim. A warm, amber-toned rice that avoids the usual teal/purple clichés.

github-anotherhadi-nixy.description: Nixy pairs NixOS with the Caelestia shell on Hyprland and Stylix-driven base16 theming. A declarative full-stack build where the whole aesthetic flows from a single Nix expression.

github-ascaniolamp-hyprlain.description: 'Hyprlain' — a Serial Experiments Lain-themed Hyprland rice with Adwaita Mono Nerd Font, waybar, dunst, hyprlock, kitty. The wallpaper does much of the heavy lifting; the desktop itself is minimal and quietly melancholy.

github-viegphunt-dotfiles.description: A clean Hyprland rice with JetBrainsMono Nerd Font, ghostty terminal, waybar + rofi + swaync + hyprlock + zsh + neovim. Nothing ornate — just a well-tuned modern Wayland developer desktop.

github-acaibowlz-niri-setup.description: Colloid-themed niri with matching Colloid icons, Adwaita cursor, Ubuntu Mono Nerd Font for UI, and JetBrainsMono Nerd Font for code. A clean scrollable-tiling setup that feels GNOME-adjacent in its restraint.

github-simonvic-dotfiles.description: Sway (with swayfx) running a dense waybar + rofi + dunst + swaylock + kitty + zsh + neovim stack, 4px borders. Practical and dark — a focused work-desktop rather than a showpiece.

hyprland-1jv48oq.description: First-rice from Reddit, 'Juno Ocean v40' theme — Hyprland + quickshell panel, hyprlock, kitty, fish + starship, thunar, vscode. Dark teal accent (#1D343A); polished despite being a first attempt.

github-redyf-nixdots.description: A TokyoNight NixOS + Hyprland rice with Zen Browser, ghostty, zsh, and Stylix-enabled consistent theming across every app. Minimalist and declarative — your whole aesthetic lives in flake.nix.

github-sly-harvey-nixos.description: Sly-Harvey's NixOS config ships a dark Hyprland desktop with Inter UI, home-manager, nix-flatpak dev shells, and plasma-manager for cross-flow between WMs. An opinionated reproducible NixOS reference.

github-caioax-lyne-dots.description: Lyne-dots uses a quickshell bar with dynamic matugen-generated colors tied to wallpaper, plus Catppuccin Mocha base, kitty, zsh + powerlevel10k, neovim. The 'lyne' CLI lets you switch themes on the fly.

github-n6v26r-dotfiles.description: A GNOME config that borrows heavily from the tiling world — polybar, rofi, dunst, hyprlock, kitty, zsh + starship, ranger, neovim, 10/20px gaps, maximalist animations. Catppuccin Mocha Lavender top to bottom.

github-youwes09-ateon.description: Ateon is an AGS/Astal + Material Design 3 Hyprland shell with matugen wallpaper-derived colors, Inter UI, JetBrainsMono Nerd Font, foot terminal, fish + starship. Maximalist animations, 5px corners.

github-elysiaos-elysiaos.description: ElysiaOS is a light-mood Hyprland build with a custom 'elysiaos-bar', its own launcher, and a muted #687363 sage accent. Feels like a distro-in-disguise — opinionated, branded, cohesive.

github-deridray-dotfiles.description: TokyoNight Hyprland with Bibata cursor, Inter UI, waybar, hyprlock, kitty, fish + starship, vscode. Maximalist animations and 20px rounded corners make it visually rich while keeping the workflow fast.

github-sekiryl-hyprdots.description: Rose Pine Purple Dark on Hyprland with matching Rose Pine icons, BreezeX cursor, SF Pro Display UI, GeistMono for code. Uses Hyprpanel; feels like a quiet, refined macOS-adjacent dark mode.

github-potamides-dotfiles.description: Awesome WM with Colloid Dark Compact Gruvbox theme, gruvbox-plus-dark icons, simp1e-gruvbox cursor, alacritty + tmux + ranger + neovim + qutebrowser. A keyboard-first, text-only kind of daily driver.

github-shikikan-neko08-nyartix-rice.description: 'Frostneko' i3 rice with Papirus icons, Iosevka Custom monospace, polybar + rofi + dunst + kitty + zsh + starship + ranger + vim. Pastel light-mood; anime-flavored without going overboard.

github-issmirnov-dotfiles.description: Hyprland rice built to mimic a macOS window-manager stack (yabai/skhd vibes) — waybar, hyprlock, alacritty, zsh, vim. Subtle animations, 15px corners, 20px gaps, FontAwesome-driven UI fonts.

github-gvolpe-nix-config.description: Niri on NixOS with a 'Juno Ocean' theme, waybar, kitty — light-mood, subtle animations, 4px gaps and corners. A deliberate, understated reference config from a known Nix contributor.

github-dybdeskarphet-dotfiles.description: Niri with Mulish UI font, JetBrainsMono Nerd Font for code, waybar + rofi + dunst + hyprlock + wezterm + fish. A measured dark setup with swww wallpaper management.

github-justus0405-i3wm-dotfiles.description: A light-mood Catppuccin i3 rice with polybar, rofi, alacritty, sddm, nemo. Easygoing and approachable — a good 'my first tiling WM' kit.

github-saschagrunert-dotfiles.description: i3 rice with Arc theme, Papirus icons, Bibata cursor, alacritty + dunst + fish + ranger + neovim. 1px borders; quiet and restrained with a Dracula.nvim editor theme for contrast.

github-keyitdev-dotfiles.description: i3 with Papirus icons, polybar + rofi + dunst + kitty + zsh + zed editor. Straightforward, light-mood, easy to learn from — a community-favorite for newcomers to i3.

github-sirethanator-hyprland-dots.description: Colloid-themed Hyprland with Bibata cursor, 0xProto Nerd Font, waybar + rofi + swaync + hyprlock + kitty + neovim. Clean and quietly modern — Colloid gives it a subtle, GNOME-flavored restraint.

github-tsm-061-ctos.description: 'ctOS' is a Wayland-only Hyprland build with quickshell, uwsm, greetd greeter and lockscreen — stripped to the essentials. JetBrainsMono Nerd Font, kitty, vscode. For users who want systemd-managed Hyprland done properly.

github-neurarian-matshell.description: Matshell is an AGS/Astal desktop shell built around matugen material-design theming — the whole UI adapts to whatever wallpaper you set. Works on both Hyprland and River.

github-pablonoya-awesomewm-configuration.description: Awesome WM config with Kuyen icons, Manrope UI font, xresources color generation, media controls in the top bar, a weather widget, and Google Calendar integration. A functional, info-rich panel.

github-orhun-dotfiles.description: Orhun Parmaksız's i3 rice — Kanagawa theme, i3bar, alacritty + bash + starship + neovim, zellij for multiplexing. Calm and readable; an everyday workspace from a well-known Rust community contributor.

github-r0naldoom-dotfiles.description: Hyprland with a Noctalia (QuickShell) panel, rofi, hyprlock, kitty, fish, neovim, maximalist animations and 20px rounded corners. Light-mood with warm accents — a fresh spin on the usual dark-rice formula.

github-opensuse-opensuseway.description: OpenSUSE's official sway reference setup — waybar, wofi, swaync, alacritty, SourceSansPro UI. Conservative and well-documented; a natural sway starter for OpenSUSE users.

github-datsfilipe-dotfiles.description: Niri with Inter UI and wezterm, managed by home-manager + Nix + sops-manager. A compact but reproducible dev-focused config spanning niri / sway / i3.

github-vyrx-dev-symphony.description: Symphony on Hyprland uses matugen dynamic theming, adw-gtk3-dark base, Bibata cursor, waybar + rofi + swaync + hyprlock + kitty + fish + starship + yazi + neovim, maximalist animations. Includes 'Symmetry' and 'Focus' custom modes.

github-cybrcore-cybrdots.description: Cybrdots ships a 12-wallpaper 'cybr palette', Inter UI, rofi + waybar + swaync, fish shell. Light-mood Hyprland that feels more boutique than typical rice — curated rather than accumulated.

hyprland-1jtjljz.description: A first-Hyprland Reddit rice with SF Pro UI and Liga SF NO Mono Nerd Font — waybar, wofi, dunst, hyprlock, kitty, fish + starship, neovim, wallust-driven wallpaper colors. Surprisingly macOS-flavored for a WM build.

github-johackim-dotfiles.description: A pywal-themed i3 rice — the colors reshape whenever you change wallpaper. polybar + dunst + zsh + neovim + rxvt; dark, terminal-first, and adaptive.

github-klaxalk-linux-setup.description: A minimal i3 + i3bar setup with Powerline fonts. Light-mood and sparse — a starting point more than a statement, good if you want a bare frame you can style yourself.

github-shell-ninja-hyprconf-v2.description: shell-ninja's second-gen Hyprland config — waybar, rofi, sddm, kitty + fish + neovim, fastfetch, dolphin file manager. Light-mood and practical; theme rotates via hyprconf-v2's wallpapers.

github-sbalghari-sbdots.description: A quiet Hyprland setup with Inter UI, waybar, rofi, kitty + fish + starship, hyprlock, Catppuccin Mocha Lavender wallpaper. Light-mood and understated — a clean daily driver more than a rice for show.

github-haaarshsingh-dots.description: i3-gaps with Adapta-Nokto theme, Qogirr cursor, Averta UI font, polybar + compton-rounded-corners + dunst + fish + starship + neovim. Pastel light-mood with real rounded corners — unusually soft for i3.

github-rayhaanfay-xfce-creation-of-adam.description: XFCE themed around the Sistine Chapel's 'Creation of Adam' — Ghost-Mantis theme, Nordzy Cyan Dark icons, JetBrainsMono Nerd Font. An artistic, unusual rice that rejects the usual Catppuccin/TokyoNight defaults.

github-dileep-kishore-nixos-config.description: Niri on NixOS with Catppuccin colors, Monaspace font, waybar, kitty, walker launcher, ghostty. A clean declarative setup that takes advantage of niri's scrollable workflow.

github-flyingcakes85-lovebites.description: LoveBites is an XFCE rice with a custom 'lovebites' theme, PapirusRed icons, Iosevka Nerd Font everywhere, tint2 + picom + conky + xfwm4. A soft, affectionate-feeling dark theme that leans warm and quiet.

github-diinki-diinki-retrofuture.description: Sway + swayfx with a custom 'diinki-retro-dark' theme, waybar, wofi, kitty. No animations, hard 1px borders, 0px rounded corners — an intentionally retro-futuristic, angular look.

github-schmeekygeek-dotfiles.description: bspwm with Iosevka Comfy Motion UI, polybar + rofi + alacritty + bash + starship + neovim, conky widgets, rose-pine wallpaper. Dark-mood and terminal-focused.

github-mastermindzh-dotfiles.description: i3-gaps with polybar, rofi, dunst, xfce4-terminal, vscode, Dracula wallpaper. 10px gaps, practical over pretty — a 'get work done' setup rather than an aesthetic showcase.

github-denisse-dev-dotfiles.description: Dracula sway rice with waybar, swaylock, alacritty, emacs. Monolike font across UI and code; dark and focused with emacs as the center of gravity.

github-mrusme-dotfiles.description: Hyprland with the premium Berkeley Mono font, waybar, mako, swaylock, zsh + starship, lf file manager, neovim. Dark, typography-forward, and quietly professional.

github-firestreaker2-dotfiles.description: A light-mood Hyprland rice with a blue theme, Adwaita cursor, JetBrainsMono Nerd Font UI, waybar + wofi + hyprlock + kitty + fish + starship + neovim. Subtle animations, 10px corners.

github-diinki-diinki-aero.description: 'Diinki-Aero' — a Windows Aero tribute on Hyprland, with crystal-remix icons, waybar, wofi, hard 1px borders, 12px corners. A rare and deliberate Windows-7-meets-Wayland aesthetic.

github-gnuunixchad-dotfiles.description: River WM with Adwaita Dark, Adwaita cursor, Noto Sans UI, dunst + foot + zsh + lf + neovim. A rare and clean River setup — Wayland tiling with GNOME-flavored defaults.

github-2kabhishek-dots2k.description: A dark XFCE rice with FiraCode Nerd Font, kitty + fish + ranger + vim — a lighter-weight, more flexible alternative to GNOME or Plasma for dev work.

github-marcusmix-dotfiles.description: A light i3 build with waybar, hyprlock, kitty, bash + neovim — maximalist animations, 10px corners. Light-mood and approachable; a Linux-Mint-adjacent tiling entry point.

github-vallen217-dotfiles.description: 'Eidolon' themed Hyprland with Kora icons, Catppuccin Mocha light cursors, waybar + rofi + dunst + hyprlock + kitty + fish + neovim, maximalist animations. Dark with a mysterious, shadowy feel.

github-shell-ninja-hyprconf.description: shell-ninja's original hyprconf — Hyprland with rofi, waybar, hyprlock, hypridle, hyprsunset, dolphin, kitty + fish + neovim, pywal-driven wallpapers. Light-mood with dynamic color changes.

github-sh1zicus-dots-hyprland.description: Hyprland with AGS widgets, Adwaita icons, Rubik UI, JetBrainsMono Nerd Font for code, anyrun launcher, foot terminal, fish + starship. Modular Hyprland config with a Material Design 3 feel.

github-felipecrs-dotfiles.description: A practical GNOME config with FiraCode Nerd Font, zsh + powerlevel10k + chezmoi for cross-machine dotfile sync, vscode. No rice theatrics — a pragmatic, reproducible developer setup.

i3wm-m7w790.description: An ArcoLinux i3 + Openbox rice themed with pywal, adi1090x's polybar themes, rofi. Light-mood, approachable, and documented — a good bridge from traditional desktop to tiling.

github-jakoolit-opensuse-hyprland.description: JaKooLit's OpenSUSE Hyprland install script and configs — Latte theme, Bibata icons, JetBrainsMono Nerd Font, zsh. A well-maintained full-featured starter for Hyprland on OpenSUSE Tumbleweed.

gnome-12dampb.description: 'Skeuowaita' — a skeuomorphic Adwaita icon remix for GNOME by Frostbitten-jello. Leans into textured, 3D-feeling icons as a deliberate pushback against flat design.

github-swarsel-dotfiles.description: Swarsel's sway config with FiraCode Nerd Font Propo, waybar, emacs. Light-mood and measured — a sway daily driver leaning on Emacs for everything editable.

github-madic-creates-sway-de.description: A Sway rice deliberately themed as Windows 10 — Windows-10 GTK theme and icon pack, waybar, bemenu, alacritty, pywal. A unique bridge for Windows-refugee users who want tiling underneath the familiar chrome.

github-edu-flores-linux-dotfiles.description: i3 with adw-gtk theme, Quintom cursor, Inter UI, JetBrainsMono Nerd Font, polybar + alacritty + zsh + rofi + dunst. Dark and practical, with GNOME-adjacent defaults bolted onto a tiling base.

github-exploitoverload-pwnixos.description: PwNixOS — a Catppuccin Hyprland NixOS build with waybar, kitty, powerlevel10k, clipse clipboard manager. Security-pentester-flavored (the name is a pun on pwn + NixOS), but the desktop itself is a clean dark dev setup.

hyprland-1inxosk.description: 'Hacker-Man' first Hyprland rice — Bibata Modern Pink cursor, CaskaydiaCove Nerd Font, swaylock, kitty, zsh + starship, yazi, waypaper. Green-black Matrix-adjacent palette with pink accents.

github-benmezger-dotfiles.description: i3 with Inter UI, polybar + rofi + dunst + i3status-rust. A quiet, focused rice — nothing flashy, just a well-tuned tiling workspace oriented around readable type.

github-deathbeam-dotfiles.description: bspwm with a quickshell panel, dunst, foot terminal, zsh + starship + neovim, 0 gaps, 1px borders, no animations. Brutalist and utilitarian — space used to the edges.

github-1amsimp1e-dots.description: 1amSimp1e's multi-branch Hyprland dots ('Late Night', 'Balcony', 'Summer') with Papirus icons, swaylock, kitty, ranger, neovim, starship. Aesthetic-first with distinct moodboards per branch.

github-athxrvx-idempotentsystems.description: Nord-themed sway with polybar, wofi, eww widgets, zsh + starship. Light-mood and minimalist; the name ('idempotent') hints at the declarative, reproducible philosophy behind it.

github-gabrieltenma-dotfiles-gnm.description: GNOME rice with Graphite-Dark theme, Product Sans UI, ArcMenu + Dash to Dock extensions, Aylur's Widgets. Keeps GNOME's polish but adds a more desktop-traditional launcher and dock.

github-command-z-z-arch-dotfiles.description: Arch + Hyprland with Catppuccin Frappe Dark cursor, Operator Mono Lig for code, waybar + eww + rofi + swaync + swaylock + kitty + zsh + starship + ranger. Dark, subtle-animation, 11px corners, 20px gaps.
